result.instructions: Tools for AgencyAnalytics, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our clients have the most keywords in the top 3 this month?"; "List all users on our account and their roles."; "Add a new client called Acme Dental with the URL acme-dental.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AgencyAnalytics data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run agencyanalytics_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run agencyanalytics_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run agencyanalytics_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. agencyanalytics_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the agency's clients (campaigns) with the fields you ask for. Good first call to find a client_id. API: asset campaign, operation read.

fields.description: Field names to return. Names come from the API playground.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client (campaign) by its id. API: asset campaign, operation read, filter id.

fields.description: Field names to return. Names come from the API playground.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client (campaign) from the given fields, for example company and url. Creates live account data. API: asset campaign, operation create.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Change fields on one client (campaign) by id. Changes live account data. API: asset campaign, operation update.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users on the account with the fields you ask for (for example role, status, campaign_access). API: asset user, operation read.

fields.description: Field names to return. Names come from the API playground.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id. API: asset user, operation read, filter id.

fields.description: Field names to return. Names come from the API playground.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: Create a user from the given fields, for example email, first_name, last_name, role. Creates live account data. API: asset user, operation create.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_update_user
tools.title: Update a user

tools.name: agencyanalytics_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: List the tracked keywords of one client, with their id. API: asset keyword, operation read, filter campaign_id.

client_id.description: The client (campaign) id. Sent as the campaign_id filter.

fields.description: Field names to return. Names come from the API playground.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_get_keyword_rankings
tools.title: Get keyword rankings
tools.description: Read keyword rankings for one client. API: asset keyword-rankings, operation read, filter campaign_id.

connector_type.description: Connector type the rankings asset expects. Leave unset for the default.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_get_client_rankings
tools.title: Get client rankings
tools.description: Read the ranking history of one client over time. API: asset campaign-rankings, operation read, filter campaign_id.

connector_type.description: Connector type the rankings asset expects. Leave unset for the default.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_list_backlinks

fields.description: Field names to return. Names come from the API playground.

tools.name: agencyanalytics_update_backlink
tools.title: Update a backlink

tools.name: agencyanalytics_create_competitor
